newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on overbought signals.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on overbought signals.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on signals the market was overbought technically after the recent rebound to levels near contract highs, traders said.
"The market sold off. It looked a little topppy and we hit the previous day's lows then sell stops were hit," a trader said.
But there was significant buying during the break and "all eyes are looking at Colombia," the trader said.
There were ideas Colombia would turn to U.S. supplies to fill at least part of their expected 140,000 rice purchase, traders said.

Colombia is set to import 140,000 tonnes of rice by May 15. U.S. exporters said Colombia will likely buy U.S. or Argentine supplies but added that vessels can reach Colombia faster and cheaper from the U.S. Gulf than from Argentina.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 1,200 contracts, below the 2,299 traded Thursday.
Rice closed six to 15-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with March down 10 at $12.16 per cwt and May down 15-1/2 at $12.17 per cwt.
